cover.report_type: Interim Report: June 19 (For the period ending June 18, 2012)

_meta.notes: The ORIGINAL June 19 interim (its amendment is key 8b7157ef, filed 7/3/12). Neither amendment box is checked. Later 2012 cover layout with no top-row 'Office' field; District Number is written 'SLCo' (the amended version writes 'N/A' in the same cell). Column B is headed 'Year to Date'. Line 5 is written '$192,391 -' with a DASH in place of the cents, recorded verbatim; the amended filing writes the same figure as $192,391.00. Column A arithmetic checks out and every Column A figure matches the amendment exactly - so the two June filings differ only in that cents notation and in the schedule detail, not in the stated totals. Signed 6/19/2012, clerk-stamped JUN 19 2012.

contributions.detail: delta -27364.00 (131262.80 itemized vs 158626.80 stated). The attached spreadsheet's last contribution is dated 06/14/2012 while the report period runs to 06/18/2012 and the attachment prints NO schedule total, so the itemized side is a FLOOR. The Summary Page's own arithmetic closes exactly on 158626.80 (line3 33,764.20 + line4 158,626.80 = line5 192,391.00; line5 - line6 95,510.54 = line7 96,880.46), so the stated total is the sound figure and was not touched.

expenditures.detail: delta +3427.70 (98938.24 from 109 transcribed rows vs the attachment's own printed 'Total: -$95,510.54' on p14, which equals Summary Page line 2 / line 6). Every amount on p12-14 was re-read in tight bands at 400 dpi and row-band detection confirms 43+43+23 rows, so this is the FILER's spreadsheet arithmetic, not a transcription gap. Both figures retained; nothing adjusted. Excluding the two in-kind rows ($1,050.00 + $200.00) does not close it either.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: No SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE is printed anywhere in this filing - the blank Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p11/p16/p17) form pages all say 'See attached' and the attachments are plain spreadsheets. The only printed schedule total is Schedule B's 'Total: -$95,510.54' on p14, and it does NOT gate (rows 98,938.24 vs printed 95,510.54). Schedule A's attachment prints no total at all, so no gate exists on the contributions side.

itemized.notes: Pages 4-10 are a LANDSCAPE spreadsheet attachment (rotate +90 to read) with a hard black county redaction over the mailing-address column; only city and state were taken from it, addresses discarded at read time. Row-band detection independently confirms 71 data rows on p4 (plus a header) and 72 on each of p5-p10 = 503 contributions; 43+43+23 = 109 expenditures on p12-14. Pages 15-18 are a SEPARATE 'Other Campaign Accounts' section (its own Summary Page on p15, blank schedules on p16/p17, and a p18 attachment for the candidate's Utah Senate campaign account: 5 expense lines totalling $5,100, contributions $0.00, balance $13,588.19 -> $8,488.19). Those lines are NOT folded into contributions/expenditures here - they are a different table with its own summary and would corrupt reconciliation against the county account's stated totals. Contribution dates print MM/DD/YYYY; expenditure dates print M/D/YY (two-digit year printed on the page, not inferred).
